annotations.title: Run a tool for every client

description: Runs one client-scoped tool once per client in the practice's own list (list_clients), passing each client's clientId in turn. Returns one row per client -- {clientId, displayName, ok, result or error} -- plus a summary count; one client's failure never stops the rest. tool is one of list_vat_obligations, submit_vat_return, get_vat_receipt, submit_micro_entity_accounts_sandbox, submit_small_company_accounts_sandbox, open_book, save_book. For the two accounts tools, put in args a codesEntryId that request_companies_house_codes answered for these clients' clientIds; each client's call takes its own codes from it.

args.description: That tool's other arguments; clientId is added per client and overrides any given here

tool.description: The client-scoped tool to run for every client

name: run_for_clients
